operations.name: Abort Copy File
operations.notes: Copies complete synchronously, so every valid request returns 409 NoPendingCopyOperation after the destination and lease checks.

operations.name: Copy File
operations.notes: Same-instance, same-account sources only, including a share snapshot source; the copy completes synchronously with x-ms-copy-status success and shares the source's extents. The host-style name {account}.file.* of a configured account is treated as local. Blob, external and cross-account sources return NotImplemented or CannotVerifyCopySource.

operations.name: Create Directory
operations.notes: Case-insensitive, case-preserving names with Azure's name, depth and length rules. File attributes, timestamps (now, preserve or ISO), permission, permission key and metadata are stored and returned with x-ms-file-id and x-ms-file-parent-id.

operations.name: Create File
operations.notes: Requires x-ms-type: file and x-ms-content-length (up to 4 TiB); replaces an existing file as Azure does, honoring its lease and read-only attribute. Content type, encoding, language, disposition, cache control, content MD5, metadata and SMB properties are stored. Content is sparse and allocates no bytes.

operations.name: Create Hard Link
operations.notes: NFS-only operation; returns 501 NotImplemented.

operations.name: Create Permission
operations.notes: Stores an SDDL string per share and returns a stable key for it. SDDL is checked only for an owner and DACL shape; it is never evaluated.

operations.name: Create Share
operations.notes: Quota (1 to 102400 GiB), access tier (TransactionOptimized, Hot, Cool) and metadata are stored and returned. SMB only: other x-ms-enabled-protocols values return NotImplemented. Provisioned IOPS and bandwidth are not modeled.

operations.name: Create Symbolic Link
operations.notes: NFS-only operation; returns 501 NotImplemented.

operations.name: Delete Directory
operations.notes: Returns DirectoryNotEmpty (409) for a non-empty directory; the share root cannot be deleted.

operations.name: Delete File
operations.notes: Requires the lease ID when leased and refuses read-only files with ReadOnlyAttribute. Extents are reclaimed once no file or snapshot references them.

operations.name: Delete Share
operations.notes: Honors x-ms-delete-snapshots (include, include-leased), ShareHasSnapshots and DeleteShareWhenSnapshotLeased, and deletes a single snapshot with sharesnapshot. Deletion is immediate; there is no soft delete.

operations.name: Force Close Handles
operations.notes: Requires x-ms-handle-id and reports zero handles closed and zero failed.

operations.name: Get Directory Metadata
operations.notes: Returns the directory's metadata and SMB headers.

operations.name: Get Directory Properties
operations.notes: Works on the share root and on share snapshots. A file at the path returns ResourceTypeMismatch.

operations.name: Get File
operations.notes: Full and ranged reads (x-ms-range or Range), x-ms-range-get-content-md5 for ranges up to 4 MiB, holes read as zeros, SAS response-header overrides, share snapshots. A range starting at or after the end returns InvalidRange. Standard If-Match, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since and If-Unmodified-Since are evaluated although Azure does not document them for Files.

operations.name: Get File Metadata
operations.notes: Returns the file's metadata.

operations.name: Get File Properties
operations.notes: HEAD with the file's size, HTTP properties, SMB properties, lease state, copy properties and metadata.

operations.name: Get File Service Properties
operations.notes: Returns 501 NotImplemented; no CORS or protocol settings are stored.

operations.name: Get Permission
operations.notes: Returns the stored SDDL for a key. Binary security descriptors (2024-11-04) are not supported.

operations.name: Get Share ACL
operations.notes: Returns up to five stored access policies.

operations.name: Get Share Metadata
operations.notes: Returns the same headers as Get Share Properties.

operations.name: Get Share Properties
operations.notes: Returns quota, access tier, metadata, enabled protocols and lease headers; honors sharesnapshot. Conditional headers are not evaluated.

operations.name: Get Share Stats
operations.notes: ShareUsageBytes is the allocated (written) bytes of the live share, so sparse files and cleared ranges do not count. Snapshots are not included.

operations.name: Get Symbolic Link
operations.notes: NFS-only operation; returns 501 NotImplemented.

operations.name: Lease File
operations.notes: Acquire (infinite only), change, release and break (immediate) with the Available, Leased and Broken states; renew is rejected. Writes, deletes, copies onto the file and renames require the lease ID, and a broken lease clears on the next unleased write. Files in share snapshots cannot be leased.

operations.name: Lease Share
operations.notes: Acquire, renew, change, release and break with fixed (15 to 60 s) or infinite durations on shares and share snapshots. State is computed lazily from the clock and survives restart. Lease-use mismatches return 412 with the FileShare operation codes from the error list rather than the 409 shown in the outcome table.

operations.name: List Directories and Files
operations.notes: Single-level listing of files and directories sorted by upper-cased name, with prefix, marker, maxresults and include=Timestamps,ETag,Attributes,PermissionKey. Names containing U+FFFE or U+FFFF are not percent-encoded.

operations.name: List Handles
operations.notes: Always returns an empty Entries list for existing directories and files because there is no SMB session to hold handles.

operations.name: List Ranges
operations.notes: Allocated ranges with adjacent ranges merged, an optional x-ms-range window, and prevsharesnapshot diffs reporting Range and ClearRange. Diffs return PreviousSnapshotNotFound, PreviousSnapshotCannotBeNewer and FileGenerationMismatch. A rewrite with identical bytes still counts as changed.

operations.name: List Shares
operations.notes: Supports prefix, marker, maxresults, include=metadata and include=snapshots; markers are opaque local tokens. include=deleted is accepted and ignored because share soft delete is not modeled.

operations.name: Put Range
operations.notes: x-ms-write update (1 byte to 4 MiB) writes a new immutable extent made durable before the metadata commits; clear deallocates the range without writing zeros. Content-MD5 and x-ms-content-crc64 are verified. A range beyond the file length returns InvalidRange. Share quota is enforced on allocated bytes and in-memory mode fails with 507 at the memory limit.

operations.name: Put Range From URL
operations.notes: Same-instance sources in the same account only, which is what AzCopy's file-to-file copy needs. Like Copy File, the source URL's SAS is not checked.

operations.name: Rename Directory
operations.notes: One row update moves the whole subtree. The source is a same-share URL; other shares or accounts return RenameAcrossAccountsAndSharesNotSupported, a destination inside the source returns RenameCycle, and an existing destination returns ResourceAlreadyExists. Open-file conflicts do not occur because handles are not modeled.

operations.name: Rename File
operations.notes: Honors x-ms-file-rename-replace-if-exists, -ignore-readonly, source and destination lease IDs, content type, metadata and SMB property overrides. Cross-share renames and share snapshots are rejected.

operations.name: Restore Share
operations.notes: Returns 501 NotImplemented; deleted shares cannot be restored.

operations.name: Set Directory Metadata
operations.notes: Replaces all metadata.

operations.name: Set Directory Properties
operations.notes: Updates attributes, timestamps and permission; absent headers preserve current values.

operations.name: Set File Metadata
operations.notes: Replaces all metadata; requires the lease ID when leased.

operations.name: Set File Properties
operations.notes: Resizes with x-ms-content-length and updates SMB properties. HTTP properties are replaced as a set only when at least one x-ms-content-* or cache-control header is sent; otherwise they are preserved, so a pure resize keeps the content type.

operations.name: Set File Service Properties
operations.notes: Returns 501 NotImplemented.

operations.name: Set Share ACL
operations.notes: Validates the SignedIdentifiers document (five policies, unique IDs of 64 characters or fewer, rcwdl permissions, ISO times). Policies are honored by service SAS tokens that name them with si.

operations.name: Set Share Metadata
operations.notes: Replaces all metadata; requires the lease ID when leased.

operations.name: Set Share Properties
operations.notes: Updates quota and access tier; requires the lease ID when the share is leased. Azure's quota-downgrade and tier-transition limits are not enforced.

operations.name: Snapshot Share
operations.notes: Copies the share's rows and shares file content by extent reference. The 200-snapshot limit is not enforced. Snapshot IDs are millisecond timestamps rendered with seven fractional digits.
